metadata.purpose: Prove that an authorized source can become cited shared memory for a new browser agent session.
metadata.learner_outcome: By the end, the viewer can verify the GitHub-session WebMCP source, status, search, read, inspection, and edit flow; a Git commit receipt plus public R2 snapshot readback; and a fresh-session read without exposing a private source body.
metadata.source_policy: Use real deployed UI and real tool operations as evidence; operational acceptance does not replace recorded evidence, and no fabricated UI may be used.
metadata.publication_target: Public YouTube demo under three minutes with clear audio.

beats.teaching_purpose: Establish the live product and the single result the viewer will verify.
beats.spoken_content: This is HatWiki, a live Git-native Wiki where people and browser agents maintain shared knowledge together. In this short demo, an authorized source becomes a cited correction that a new agent session can read through WebMCP.

narration_spine.name: English opening and outcome pickup
narration_spine.production_method: Record a human voiceover after the live URL and WebMCP host are verified.
narration_spine.acceptance: The opening names HatWiki, the live environment, and the concrete source-to-fresh-session outcome without introducing unused features.

visual_slots.name: Live HatWiki home and Knowledge Loom
visual_slots.production_method: Capture the deployed HatWiki home page without private browser data.
visual_slots.acceptance: The live URL, HatWiki identity, and Knowledge Loom are readable.

beats.teaching_purpose: Show the existing page, the signed-in participant's source declaration, and the human-facing task before the Agent acts.
beats.spoken_content: Our task is to improve an existing human-written research page without exposing a private source body. A GitHub-signed-in participant provides one small authorized plain-text source for the existing page, then reviews the same cited Wiki page a normal reader can browse.

narration_spine.name: English source and task setup pickup
narration_spine.production_method: Record a concise task statement over the selected Wiki page, source declaration, and task receipt while redacting source text and account details.
narration_spine.acceptance: The existing page, source declaration, privacy boundary, and fresh-session success condition are all understandable.

visual_slots.name: Agent2UCB page, source declaration, and citation context
visual_slots.production_method: Capture the public Wiki index, Agent2UCB page, source declaration, citation, and table of contents without showing the source body.
visual_slots.acceptance: The selected page is visibly existing and source-aware, while private source text and account details remain absent or redacted.

beats.teaching_purpose: Prove that the signed-in browser Agent uses the WebMCP source, status, search, and read tools before proposing a cited change.
beats.spoken_content: The Agent uses add_source to create the authorized private task, then get_ingestion_status to read its owner-scoped, untrusted text. It uses search_wiki and read_page to find the existing Agent2UCB page and its evidence boundary instead of guessing from temporary conversation context.

narration_spine.name: English WebMCP source-handoff pickup
narration_spine.production_method: Record human narration after a real signed-in WebMCP host completes add_source, get_ingestion_status, search_wiki, and read_page without exposing the source body.
narration_spine.acceptance: The recording visibly proves all four tool calls, the page ID, bounded search result, citations, and revision while source text remains redacted.

visual_slots.name: WebMCP source, status, search, and read evidence
visual_slots.production_method: Capture the real external Agent host and redact private session details and all source text.
visual_slots.acceptance: add_source, get_ingestion_status, search_wiki, and read_page names and bounded public results are readable.

beats.teaching_purpose: Make the pre-write inspection, publication declaration, cited write, and durable revision visible in one continuous sequence.
beats.spoken_content: Use inspect_changes to review the affected page, citations, WikiLinks, and unresolved markers before submitting anything. Propose one small clarification, then show the participant's explicit declaration that they may publish it. edit_page submits the cited change; the server validates it, returns a Git commit receipt, and makes the committed content available in the public R2 snapshot. Repeating the same request returns its original receipt instead of another write.

narration_spine.name: English inspection, authorization, and write-path pickup
narration_spine.production_method: Record the agent proposal, inspect_changes result, explicit publication declaration, authenticated edit_page call, idempotent replay, and result in one controlled take.
narration_spine.acceptance: The inspection and declaration are explicit, the edit has a visible source citation, and the Git commit receipt, public snapshot, Git commit or diff, and idempotent replay are visible.

visual_slots.name: inspect_changes, edit_page, Git commit, and R2 snapshot
visual_slots.production_method: Capture the real authenticated inspection and write flow, then show GitHub and R2 readback without exposing credentials or private source text.
visual_slots.acceptance: The Git commit or diff and public R2 snapshot show the committed content; they are not presented as the same revision identifier.

unresolved_work.name: Recorded Gate C write-flow evidence
unresolved_work.production_method: Capture the completed external-host inspection, declaration, cited edit, GitHub and R2 readback, and idempotent replay as a redacted raw take.
unresolved_work.acceptance: The raw take proves the real external-host operation without displaying credentials, account details, or the private source body.

beats.teaching_purpose: Prove that the new state is shared memory rather than context hidden in the first Agent session.
beats.spoken_content: Now I open a fresh agent session. It can read the corrected page, its citation, and the new revision without inheriting the previous conversation or private source body. The shared memory is the public Wiki and Git history, not the chat transcript.

narration_spine.name: English fresh-session validation and closing pickup
narration_spine.production_method: Record a new browser-Agent session reading the updated public page, then close on the updated page and Knowledge Loom without sharing the first session's context.
narration_spine.acceptance: The fresh session reads the corrected sentence and current revision without accessing the private source body; the close states the human/Agent boundary.

visual_slots.name: Fresh-session readback and final Knowledge Loom
visual_slots.production_method: Capture a genuinely new session and the updated public page after commit, GitHub readback, and R2 publication, with session details redacted.
visual_slots.acceptance: The second session visibly reads the new public state without relying on the first session's transcript or private source body.

unresolved_work.name: Recorded fresh-session evidence
unresolved_work.production_method: Capture the already verified fresh-session readback against the deployed revision as a redacted raw take.
unresolved_work.acceptance: The raw take shows a new session reading the updated page, citation, and revision without private context.
